name: Fish Audio S2 Pro
access: Fish Audio API: POST /v1/tts, `model` header s2-pro
Hugging Face weights fishaudio/s2-pro with fine-tuning code and an SGLang-based streaming inference engine

voice.input_audio: none: the model takes text, with inline [bracket] cues, speaker tags and phoneme tags
voice.output_audio: wav, pcm, mp3 (64, 128 or 192 kbps) and opus (automatic, or 24 to 64 kbps); the sample rate is the format default (44.1 kHz for most, 48 kHz for opus) unless set [fish-openapi]
voice.voices: custom cloning from reference audio (zero-shot, or a saved voice model), a Voice Library, and candidate voices from a natural-language prompt through the voice design endpoint [fish-openapi] [fish-voice-design]
languages: 80+ languages with automatic language detection; Tier 1 is Japanese, English and Chinese; Tier 2 is Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, Arabic, Russian, French and German [fish-hf-s2] [fish-models]
voice.latency: About 100 ms time to first audio and a real-time factor of 0.195 on one H200 GPU, per the maker's model card and models page [fish-hf-s2] [fish-models]. A separate SGLang write-up gives a real-time factor of 0.34 and 63.3 tokens a second on one H200 at batch size 1 [sglang-s2]
voice.session_limit: The text limit per request was not found in the pages read; the server processes text in chunks of 100 to 300 characters (default 300), and the WebSocket takes text events between a start and a stop event [fish-openapi]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per UTF-8 byte of input text: US$15.00 per 1M bytes for `s2.1-pro` and for `s2-pro`; Fish Audio says 1M bytes is about 180,000 English words or about 12 hours of speech [fish-pricing]. `s2.1-pro-free` runs the same model as `s2.1-pro` at US$0 under a fair-use policy, with no latency guarantee, possible data retention for model improvement, and an end date of 2026-11-30 in the launch post [fish-models] [fish-blog-s21]. Voice design costs US$0.01 per successful request [fish-pricing]. Artificial Analysis lists US$15 per 1M characters [aa-tts-board]
